description: This file defines a mock class WorkerThreadMock for testing purposes, which implements the IWorkerThread interface. It includes mock methods for stop, join, and enqueueTask, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace.

classes.name: WorkerThreadMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IWorkerThread interface for testing, providing mock methods for thread control and task enqueueing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks the stop method to halt the worker thread.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Mocks the join method to wait for the worker thread to finish.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Mocks the enqueueTask method to add a task to the worker thread's queue.
